projects.title: 把 Tripo Studio 连接到 Codex 的插件
projects.author: bugyaluwang
projects.summary: ![Tripo Studio for Codex Banner]( https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GrinZero/tripo-studio-plugin/main/docs/images/banner.png) 为什么是 **Link your Tripo Studio**，而不是 **Tripo API**？ 最近在用 Codex 写自己的 3D / 游戏项目时，我发现现有的官方工具只支持 Tripo API： 1. **明明开了网页端会员，调 API 还得再交一份钱**：很多创作者和独立开发者手里本来就有 **Tripo Studio 网页端会员**（每个月有大量套餐积分），但官方 API Key 的计费池是完全独立的——想在 Agent 里自动化生成模型，还得额外掏钱充值 API Credits 。 2. **我们需要的是整个「 Studio 工作流」，而不是裸调一个无状态接口**：做 3D 资产不是发个 Prompt 拿回一个 URL 就完事了。以往我们要在「浏览器输入 Prompt ➔ 手动下载 GLB ➔ 拖进 Blender 查面数和流形 ➔ 姿势不对切回网页重刷 ➔ 绑骨骼调动作 ➔ 导出 FBX 塞进工程目录」之间反复横跳。 所以我做了一个开源的 Codex 插件 —— **[Tripo Studio for Codex]( https://github.com/GrinZero/tripo-studio-plugin)**（ MIT License ），刚刚发布了最新的 **v0.3.4** 版本。 它不走额外的 API Key 计费中转，而是**直接把你的 Tripo Studio 网页端账号、完整创作管线、可视化工作台以及本地 Blender 后处理引擎，原封不动地连进了 Codex**。 --- ### 💡 连入 Tripo Studio 意味着什么？ #### 1. BYO Studio Account：直接复用网页端会员与积分，零 API 溢价 插件直接复用本机的 Tripo Studio 网页登录会话，无需申请和购买 API Key 。你在网页端订购的会员积分，现在可以直接在 Codex 对话框里调用 Studio 全套最新算力： - **High Detail (H2.5 / H3.0 / H3.1)**：高精度几何建模 + 2K/4K/8K PBR 材质与局部重绘 - **Smart Mesh P2**：严格控制在 500–25,000 面的规整四边面网格，支持单次生成多个面数预算变体 - **多视角对齐建模**：支持正/左/背/右四视图一致建模 - **Rig V3 绑骨 & AI Motion**：自动适配 Mixamo / UE Mannequin / Unity Humanoid 标准骨架，支持文本生成连贯动作并重定向 #### 2. 不止是对话：68 个 MCP 工具 + 内嵌 Studio 可视化工作台（ MCP Apps ） 纯靠聊天调 3D 参数像开盲盒，纯靠点网页 UI 又没法让 Agent 帮你批量干活并直接写入代码仓库。基于 **Codex MCP Apps**，我们把 Studio 界面直接搬进了 Codex： - **三合一内嵌工作台**：随时在聊天中唤起包含「资产中心、任务队列、创建面板」的工作台，顶栏**实时显示当前账号的 Studio 剩余积分**。 - **60 秒防手滑确认卡片**：Agent 准备发起生成或编辑时，默认先弹出可交互的参数确认卡片（展示输入视图快照、网格/贴图配置与本地秒算的预估积分）。**卡片真正渲染可见后才开始 60s 倒计时，点击编辑立刻暂停**，彻底杜绝 AI 误操作偷跑你的会员积分。 ![60 秒防手滑参数确认卡片]( https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GrinZero/tripo-studio-plugin/main/docs/images/configuration-dark.png) ### 🚀 1 分钟安装上手 **直接复制下面这段话发给你的 Codex ，让 AI 自己帮你装好**： ```text 请帮我安装 Tripo Studio for Codex 插件。 项目地址： https://github.com/GrinZero/tripo-studio-plugin 请先检查本机是否有 Node.js ≥ 22 、npm / npx 和支持插件的 Codex CLI ，缺少时帮我安装或配置。 然后执行以下命令： codex plugin marketplace add https://github.com/GrinZero/tripo-studio-plugin.git --ref main codex plugin add tripo-studio-plugin@tripo-studio-plugins 安装成功后提醒我开启新聊天，再发送“检查 Tripo Studio 登录状态，需要的话帮我登录”，然后发送“打开 Tripo 工作台”。 ``` --- ### 🔗 开源地址 - **GitHub （ MIT 开源，求个 Star ⭐）**： https://github.com/GrinZero/tripo-studio-plugin - **NPM**： https://www.npmjs.com/package/tripo-studio-plugin 欢迎手里有 Tripo 会员、平时做独立游戏、Web3D 、3D 打印或者重度使用 Codex 的朋友试试看，有任何问题或建议欢迎直接在帖子里交流或提 Issue ！

projects.title: Show HN: Guilds – Open-source inspectable multi-agents collaboration framework
projects.author: 0mbre
projects.summary: Getting AI to handle long-running tasks reliably takes more than good prompts. There’s a lot of system design involved: figuring out how agents should work together, anticipating edge cases, and being able to debug and tune the system when things go wrong. That’s why we built guilds.run. The goal is to make the whole system understandable, so you can trace how mistakes propagate between agents, fix the underlying causes, and see if your changes work. We’re open-sourcing guilds.run because we’d like to see what other people built and share working team the solve real world use cases for long running agent collaboration

projects.title: 关于展示性网页+个人博客重构, 从 halo 和 wordpress 中摆脱出来, 意外发现很有意思的动静态结合的方法
projects.author: woodchen
projects.summary: > 一个从 wordprss 迁移, 一个从 halo 迁移, 由于场景不同, 写了两套, 但基本逻辑类似. ## 迁移理由 1. wordpress 的速度可以优化, 但是扩展不是很方便, 不像私有仓库, push, deploy 自动化 2. halo 的 java 内存占用高, 并且又去搞商城, 还有这种奇怪的变动让我文章页面错误好几周(有部分文章以前从 typecho 迁移到 halo, 文章 url 没变) `升级 2.22.x 后, slug 为四位数, 比如 1207 时, 访问文章, 变成 文章归档 页面` 3. 自定义扩展方便, 多语言, ai 自动翻译, ai 优化 seo, mcp. ## 非纯静态理由 1. 需要 MCP 给 agent 去发 2. 需要接入 ai 模型做文章翻译, SEO 描述, 自动做 ai 任务队列 3. 需要动态改内容, 并且内置 indexnow 4. 阅读数动态统计什么的 5. 方便 ## 非纯动态理由 1. 速度 2. ai 方便抓取和阅读 3. 没有必要 ## 方法 1. 后端 go 2. 管理端动态网页, 可以绑定其他域名或放 url 路径 当内容变更, go 来负责`next build`, 构建静态网页, 然后可以通过下面两种方式去分发. 1. 另起容器, 共享前端网页卷, 如果有需要后端 api, 可反代几个动态接口到 后端 build 容器 2. 直接放一个容器, go-web-utils/nextstatic 来负责处理 next 静态文件路由 效果还不错. ![image.png]( https://i.czl.net/b2/img/26-10/6aca77582ccb1.png) 我的博客: 可以看看

projects.summary: 阮老师好，自荐一个刚开源的本地复式记账桌面工具 BeanDesk（经营账本）。 GitHub 安装包下载： （支持 macOS Apple Silicon & Intel / Windows / Linux） 为什么做这个工具？ 很多独立开发者、一人公司（OPC）和小微企业在日常经营中都有记账和报税的需求： 用商业财务 SaaS，往往不放心把公司真实的银行流水和账目传到别人的云端服务器； 用 Beancount / Fava 做纯文本复式记账，又面临 Python 环境折腾、缺乏符合国内习惯的标准报表（尤其现金流量表）、以及手写分录门槛高的问题； 直接让大模型算账，则经常出现借贷不平或加减法幻觉。 BeanDesk 的定位是一个“本地化的 AI 财税副手”：基于 Tauri 2 构建，不设云端账号、无需自建数据库，账目与发票凭证完全留在本地电脑；同时通过内置的本机 MCP 服务让 AI 协助日常录账与合规核查，底层用确定性的会计引擎杜绝大模型幻觉。 核心特性 1. 真正开箱即用，免配环境：安装包内置了冻结的核算引擎运行时，无需在电脑上安装配置 Python 或敲命令行，打开软件选定文件夹即可一键初始化标准账套（内置中国企业会计准则 CAS 与国际准则模板）。 2. 标准财务三张表：除试算平衡表外，即时生成规范的资产负债表、利润表、现金流量表，经营成果、资金流向与报税口径一目了然。 3. AI 随手记 + 强规则防幻觉：同一可执行文件自带本机 stdio MCP 服务，可接入 Claude Desktop、Cursor 等 AI 客户端。AI 负责理解自然语言票据并提议分录，本地引擎通过 bean-check 与内置会计规则强制核验借贷平衡，算错一分钱都会被拦截。 4. 原始凭证留存与穿透核对：日记账分录可直接关联并弹窗预览本地的 PDF 发票与银行回单原件，账证合一。 5. 本地快照与加密备份：内置 Git 自动版本快照，并集成 Restic 支持将账本与凭证加密增量备份到本地其他硬盘或 S3 兼容存储（R2 / MinIO / AWS S3）。 6. 报税与付款日程提醒：支持导入或订阅 .ics 日历，关键申报节点提前桌面提醒。 界面预览 试算平衡与经营大盘： 标准现金流量表： 交易明细与原始凭证穿透： 项目采用 AGPL-3.0 协议完全免费开源，希望能帮到同样在折腾一人公司或小微企业经营的朋友。感谢阮老师审阅！

projects.author: zw-onemaker-ai

github.name: zw-onemaker-ai/agent_gate
github.description: AI Agent 管线可靠性操作系统 —「Agent 管编，闸门管信」：一句话需求 → 自动 Agent 团队 → 每步验证拦截 → 定向回环自愈

projects.summary: 阮老师好，自荐一个开源项目： 它是一个多 Agent 管线的「可靠性层」。起因是我用多个 AI Agent 协作跑 12 步开发管线，被「静默失败」坑了很多次：Agent 说「测试全过」，实际没跑；说「文件写好了」，磁盘上是空的。我统计了一下，不加验证的管线成功率只有六成左右，而且大部分失败没有任何报错。 AgentGate 的思路是把「不信任」做成机制：每个 Agent 的产出必须过三道闸门才算数——① 产出文件真实存在且非空；② 所有验证命令必须贴出 EXITCODE（Agent 可以编话，编不了退出码）；③ 面向用户的产出过脱敏检查。任何一道不过，按错误类型定向回环给对应 Agent 修，连续失败升级人工闸门。 几个我觉得有意思的点：执行调度是纯规则引擎，一行大模型都不调——PASS/FAIL 可追查、可复现；管线跑到一半崩了能断点恢复；127 个测试全过。仓库里有 3 个 Demo，clone 下来不用模型、不用 key，一条命令就能看到闸门怎么拦截假产出。 MIT 协议，欢迎提 issue 和拍砖。

projects.title: 做了个开源 Mac App：用 adb 在 Mac 上看清、管好家里的安卓电视、盒子和手机
projects.author: xxzhaoming
projects.summary: 起因是客厅的安卓电视。打开开发者模式、用 adb 连上以后，发现能读到的东西特别多：屏幕开没开、前台是哪个 App 、正在播什么、开机多久、内存存储、最近的使用记录……只是全都藏在命令行里。于是用 Claude Code 写了个 Mac App ，把这些都摆出来，顺手把常用的操作也做了。不只是电视，安卓盒子、手机、平板都能用。 GitHub： https://github.com/zhaoweijia1997/Sideboard （截图在 README 里） ## 能看到什么 - **总览**：屏幕状态（亮屏 / 熄屏 / 屏保）、前台 App 、正在播放的内容、开机时长、CPU 、内存、存储、网络、温度、音量 - **最近 24 小时**：什么时候开关机、亮屏熄屏、打开过哪些 App 。数据来自安卓自己的使用记录，Sideboard 没开的时候发生的事也看得到 - **长期记录**：存在 Mac 上，按周 / 按月看每天亮屏多久，攒满四周还有「每天几点亮屏」的热力图 - **体检**：每个 App 用了多少流量、最近的崩溃和无响应、谁在偷偷唤醒设备 - **详细信息**：型号、系统版本、芯片、分辨率和刷新率、Wi-Fi 信号、电源和待机设置、深度睡眠时长 ## 能做什么（只在你点的时候） - **实时画面**：在 Mac 窗口里实时显示设备屏幕，点击就是点屏幕、拖动就是滑动，方向键当遥控器 - 遥控器、截屏、录屏，图片和视频直接存到 Mac - App 管理：卸载、停用预装 App （随时能恢复）、导出 APK - 文件管理：浏览、上传下载、拖进窗口就传过去；拖进 `.apk` 就安装 - 清理：应用缓存、已卸载 App 的残留、安装包。大文件只列出来，不替你勾 - 在设备上打开链接：从 Safari 拖个链接到窗口上就行 - 菜单栏常驻：深夜电视还开着、存储快满、发热、有 App 被装上或卸掉，都会发通知 ## 几条原则 - **不改设备的任何设置**，包括待机设置；熄屏时只偶尔看一眼，不让设备睡不着 - **设备上不留东西**：截图、录屏直接传回 Mac ，临时文件随手删掉 - **数据不离开你的 Mac**：没有账号，没有统计，不联网上传 设备上什么都不用装。有个可选的配套 App （约 120 KB ，不申请联网权限），装上能多出 90 天的记录、App 图标，以及从 Mac 往电视里输入中文。 ## 怎么用 1. 装 adb：`brew install --cask android-platform-tools` 2. 设备上打开开发者选项里的 USB 调试或网络调试 3. 从 GitHub 的 Releases 下载 dmg 。还没做苹果公证，第一次打开要右键 →「打开」 需要 macOS 14 及以上，Apple 芯片和 Intel 都行。MIT 开源，界面有 7 种语言。 还是早期版本（ 0.6 ），欢迎试用、提 issue ，或者回帖说说你想用它干什么。

projects.title: Show HN: Higherlevel – Define and review what AI agents build
projects.author: cyan_indigo
projects.summary: Hi HN! I'm Ryan, I'm building Higherlevel ( https://higherlevel.to ) so product teams have one place to define and review software changes. Over the last couple of years, I've been increasingly delegating software implementation to AI coding agents. However, because it became easier and faster to ship complexity, I realised that it still takes me quite some time to even understand what the software is doing, why it is doing that, or review the changes. I also don't do traditional code reviews anymore, it's mostly automated but I still want to review the final outcome of the changes (rather than its implementation). I regularly work on complex B2B applications where a single feature can involve dozen of business rules, edge cases and interactions with existing functionality. I found myself spending more and more time discovering and explaining requirements to agents, reviewing their output, asking for evdience and trying to establish whether we actually agreed on what correct behaviour looked like. So I built Higherlevel. The idea is to bring product specifications and proof of work into a single collaborative workspace. You can: - describe the current behaviour, known limitations and expected changes - define business rules, acceptance scenarios using Given/When/Then - demand evidence in the form of a screenshot, a video, etc - comment directly on the spec, on a specific area of the image or a timestamp of the video - discuss changes, track revisions and approve results with your team I've written extensively about why I believe in specification driven development (and what it means to me) here https://higherlevel.to/blog/introducing-higherlevel Higherlevel is currently in beta and built with Elixir, Phoenix LiveView, and PostgreSQL.

projects.title: Show HN: APIblaze – Serverless MCP and API gateway with everything built in
projects.author: jayjaychicago
projects.summary: Hi HN. There are lots of API gateways out there. What we couldn't find was one with everything built-in to go from “my business logic works” to “I can safely consider publishing it on the internet”. So we spent a year building the features in APIblaze: A serverless MCP and API gateway. Here’s what makes it different: - Authorization. Most gateways stop at authentication: they check who is calling. What they can and cannot do is left to your code or a plugin connecting to some sort of complex Authorization system. APIblaze provides users & groups management and enforces Authorization policies at the gateway, as a default suggested from your API spec. You add groups and write Authorization rules in plain English ("only whoever created a record, or an admin, can read or change that record"), tested and enforced by the gateway. - Hosted end to end. APIblaze hosts the MCP server, the gateway, OAuth discovery and the login pages on the internet. One thing we really wanted to make easy was local development so the hosted API gateway forwards the requests to your backend, even if this backend runs on your localhost. So you can connect Claude/ChatGPT/… to the hosted MCP, bring your own oAuth and log into it (which is important because MCPs are all about taking actions and you have to know “who” is taking those actions), chat with your API to test it, and change your code live while the calls stream in your terminal. - UI widgets: self-service API keys, users and groups and chat window. A drop-in React widget lets your users create, rotate and revoke their own keys on the developer section of your site. Another lets your customers' admins manage their own users and groups. A last one lets end users chat with your API on your App. - Multi-tenant. Each customer gets its own keys, users, portal and MCP address to serve their own service to their end-users. - The usual gateway tools: rate limits and quotas, transformations, custom domains and more. - No lock-in: one command exports your setup (config, users, groups, and API keys as hashes so your callers keep theirs) to a runnable Kong bundle once you outgrow APIblaze. To try it, paste this prompt into Claude Code or Codex, in an empty folder (you get a sample app) or in your backend's folder: > Show me what APIblaze does using npx apiblaze skills Or by hand, no sign-up needed: npx apiblaze create --target https://ninopizzas.com/openapi.yaml It's in beta. I'd love your feedback, what you like and what you don't.

projects.title: Show HN: Railcode – Secure cloud for internal software
projects.author: yakkomajuri
projects.summary: Hey HN, Yakko here from Railcode. Railcode is like an internal Vercel for your company. We built it after speaking to dozens of engineering leaders at various companies where employees were given access to Claude Code or Codex and started to build little tools (apps, agents) locally, but then struggled to share it with coworkers securely. Typical scenarios are: 1. Employees can't share what they've built because of internal policies 2. Agents find the path of least resistance and deploy things on e.g. Vercel, leading to a sprawl of software that's a nightmare to manage (disjointed auth or no auth, API keys handled insecurely, no centralized management, etc.) 3. Companies set up templates to ensure some standardization but still require engineers in the loop to review and deploy code Neither of these options felt great, so we built Railcode to be the place to deploy and manage internal software inside a company, ensuring projects are deployed securely, follow the same patterns, and can be easily managed from one place. The goal is to unblock users to deploy and share what they've built while removing the burden on Engineering/DevOps to review and manage it all. How we do this: - Company auth in front of everything that's deployed - Permissioned connectors to access data instead of shared API keys - Infrastructure building blocks that make it easy to store data or use an LLM but allows admins to oversee everything (via a simple SDK) - Centralized audit logs - Unified design system (optional) - Role-based access control with granular permissions that can be inherited by the projects themselves The platform is built to be really low friction for agents and to not require folks changing their workflows. We support static frontends and serverless JS functions for the backend, meaning Tanstack, Hono, Vite, React, etc will all work. Even Next.js with OpenNext though that has some quirks :D Projects run locally and everything Railcode-specific comes from an optional SDK. We ship a skill and a CLI and that's all you need to build and deploy projects or have agents manage configuration. Keen to hear feedback! https://railcode.dev/

projects.title: 【开源自荐】Ginno：本地优先的个人 AI Agent，数据不出本机，自带可视化工作流
projects.author: robscc
projects.summary: 背景 Claude Code 这类 Agent 的形态很好用，但我想给「个人使用」做一个完整的桌面形态：数据不出本机，工具 / 权限 / 技能 / 工作流有统一的界面，流程可编排、运行可观察。 于是用业余时间做了两个多月，自己每天在用（dogfooding），迭代了 220+ 次提交，目前是能日常干活的状态。 它是什么 Ginno 是一个 本地优先（local-first）的个人 AI Agent 桌面应用（macOS）。 一条设计原则贯穿始终：你的数据不离开你的机器。 无数据库：所有状态是 ~/.ginno/ 下的 JSON / JSONL / Markdown，可读、可手改、可进 git 无账号、无云同步：打开即用；拷走文件夹就能搬家 自带模型 Key：OpenAI / Anthropic / DeepSeek 或任意兼容端点；Ginno 只是客户端，不托管你的 Key 和数据 技术栈：Tauri 2（Rust 桌面壳）+ Next.js 前端 + Python 运行时（FastAPI / LangGraph）。 能力上： 多 Agent 对话：会话中随时切换 Agent，共享历史、各自独立记忆 工具 · 权限 · 技能 · MCP · Hooks：Claude Code 同款形态，全部内置 可视化 Workflow Studio：一份带版本的 DSL，编译成 LangGraph 状态图执行，运行过程实时观察 本地知识库：索引你的 Obsidian 仓库，回答带引用来源 长程 Goal + TODO：让 Agent 持续推进一个长期目标，并和待办同步 内置浏览器 + 联网搜索：检索带来源标注 效果 工作区： Workflow Studio（可视化编排 + 运行观察）： 本地知识库： 安装 macOS（Apple Silicon）： 安装包（推荐）：Releases 下载 Ginno0.1.0aarch64.dmg（未签名，首次打开请右键 → 打开） 或从源码运行： bash git clone cd ginno pnpm install cd packages/runtime && uv sync cd ../.. && pnpm dev 其他 MIT 开源。项目还很早期，API 和 UI 迭代很快；欢迎试用，欢迎提 Issue / PR，中英文都行。

projects.author: rootSunc

github.description: 中国 A 股数据基础设施。55个日更数据集：股票行情、基本面、期货数据、资金面、公告事件、指数行业、宏观与风险。行级溯源、PIT 语义、复权与历史成分内置，MCP 原生。自托管，零注册、零 API Token

projects.summary: CNEquity 是一个开源、自托管的 A 股数据湖：把行情、财报、资金面、公司事件、宏观和期货期权等 55 个数据集采集到本地 Parquet，做增量更新、失败续跑和质量审计，再通过 Python、SQL、网页控制台和 MCP 统一查询。 做量化研究或回测时，常见的痛点是：每次都要重新拉数据、中断了要从头来、不知道这份数据是哪天从哪个接口拿的，以及最隐蔽的——用「今天还在交易的股票」去回测过去，悄悄漏掉了退市股（幸存者偏差），或者用了事后才披露的财报（未来函数）。CNEquity 把这些口径做进了数据层：退市股保留在历史股票池里，财报按 asof 只返回当时已披露的数据，原始价和复权因子分开存。 它也是一个 MCP 服务，可以把整个 A 股数据湖接给 Claude、ChatGPT、Cursor、Codex 等 AI 助手，让 AI 直接用 SQL 查历史数据，回答里自带复权和覆盖口径。 核心功能 55 个数据集：日线 / 分钟线、复权因子、财报、估值、北向、融资融券、龙虎榜、公告、行业成分、宏观、期货期权与 Greeks 等 一分钟试用：cne init --profile demo 用真实数据源抓 5 只股票，立刻能查 研究口径正确：保留退市股、PIT 财报、复权方式查询时再选，每行带来源和版本 断点续跑：中断后重跑同一条命令，已下载的批次不会重来 网页控制台：cne serve 查看覆盖、新鲜度、质量，还能从页面发起日更和回填 接给 AI：cne mcp 提供 6 个只读工具（含 DuckDB SQL），支持 stdio 和 Streamable HTTP，已登记到官方 MCP Registry 中英文双语：文档和控制台都有中英文两套 快速开始 bash pip install cnequity cne init --profile demo # 约 1 分钟，建一个小 demo 湖 cne serve --config configs/cnequity.demo.toml # 打开网页控制台 完整的沪深京全市场：cne init（近 3 年，首次需要几个小时，可随时中断续跑）。 开源协议：Apache-2.0

projects.title: Show HN: Bees – Run agentic teams on your own computer (open source)
projects.author: ravikapoor101
projects.summary: Author here. Bees is an agentic harness that runs on your own machine — macOS, Windows and Linux, MIT/Apache 2.0. The problem we kept hitting in client work: every agent platform wanted to be the place your documents live. We wanted the opposite — the orchestrator reads your files in place, on your disk, and we never see them. How it works: you describe work in plain English, Bees proposes the agents, stages, tools and schedule, and nothing runs until you apply it. Agents execute locally in their own run folders. A separate reviewer agent checks output before it advances a stage. Agents stop and ask for approval before external side effects like sending mail. Coordination is deliberately thin. In a Regular org we sync team membership, process runs and stages, work claims, and file names with relative paths. Not contents. If you want no third party at all, pick a local model and local tools and it runs fully offline. Model routing is BYO: local models, your own API keys, or the official Claude Code CLI you already have installed and signed into as yourself. We don't intermediate credentials and we add no per-token or per-run fee — that's the whole point. Rough edges, honestly: {name the two weakest things — I'd lead with whatever your beta testers actually complained about}. Scripted installers exist but Linux distro coverage is the thinnest. Very happy to answer architecture questions, and I'd particularly like pushback from anyone running multi-machine setups. Repo: https://github.com/Bees-bot/bees-desktop/

projects.title: Show HN: Delegator – Stop juggling coding-agent sessions
projects.author: mattm
projects.summary: I wanted to share Delegator with the HN community. delegator gives you a personal inbox to manage your tasks that is completely local to your machine. Backstory: Like everyone else, I've been experimenting with different AI-assisted development workflows. I realized I was having difficulty with all the context switching between tasks. Asking agents to develop code ends up taking about 5-10 minutes usually for well-scoped tasks. At the beginning I would read the AI output as it went along and sometimes interrupt to guide it. But as LLMs have gotten better, there's less need to do that. So I would spin up another task during the latency and then another. (I wrote a little bit about this previously here https://mattmccormick.ca/we-re-all-managers-now-my-journey-i... ) Jumping back and forth between terminals with the Agent being at different stages was mentally taxing. I experimented with some different options and ended up realizing that to avoid the drain of context-switching, what I really needed was a queue. Delegator works by putting all scoped tasks through the system. It stops when the ready queue has reached your configured limit. This is to prevent too much work from piling up waiting for review. It also presents the work from getting too far ahead in case any issues are found as part of development. I also realized that for most tasks, agents can be treated as a background process. You pass in the work to the process. It processes it and then gives you an output to review. All changes are made in git worktrees for safety. Who's it for? Delegator is for engineers who still want to understand the code and changes. It's not for vibe-coding or exploratory work. Don't get me wrong, I'll still spin up an agent session for brainstorming design options. But once I'm aligned on a direction, I'll then ask the agent to break down the work into "dg tickets". Since Delegator is a local program, agents can interact with it quickly and seamlessly. Right now it's just CLI based but I'm looking to expand this into a GUI/Desktop App so I would be interested in any feedback you have. Let me know if you have any questions and I'll respond. The code is source available so you can check it out at https://github.com/alcubie/delegator if you want to check anything.

projects.summary: massCode 是一个开源的桌面开发者工作区，支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux。它最早是一个代码片段管理器，现在把代码片段、技术笔记、HTTP 客户端和常用开发小工具放在同一个应用里。 API 请求、调用它的代码和相关说明通常分散在三个不同的工具里。在 massCode 中，它们放在一起，可以互相链接，并且全部以普通 Markdown 文件保存在本地磁盘上。 核心特性 1. 代码片段：多级文件夹、标签、片段内多文件/多语言（fragments），支持 160 多种语法高亮。 2. 笔记：Markdown 笔记，用 [[链接]] 关联笔记、代码片段和 HTTP 请求；支持任务（状态、优先级、截止日期）、Mermaid 和思维导图。 3. HTTP 客户端：集合、环境变量、GraphQL、WebSocket、断言与脚本、按顺序运行请求；可从 OpenAPI、Postman、Bruno 导入。 4. 小工具：计算笔记本、基于 Excalidraw 的画板，以及 JSON Diff、哈希、编码/解码等工具。 5. AI 助手：使用自己的 API Key（OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini、DeepSeek 等），或通过 Ollama、LM Studio 使用本地模型。 6. MCP：Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等编程智能体可以搜索和保存你的代码片段、笔记和 HTTP 请求。仅在本机监听，默认关闭。 7. 本地优先：没有账号，没有私有云。数据就是本地文件夹里的 Markdown 文件，可以用 iCloud Drive、Dropbox、Syncthing 或 Git 同步。

projects.summary: mu 是一个开源的编程 Agent，有命令行和桌面端，基于 pi 与 AionUi。Agent 每一轮都要做不少和代码无关的小判断：哪段工具输出该进上下文、被规则拦下的命令是不是用户要的、网页里有没有冲着 AI 的指令、"做完了"有没有验证过。mu 把这些交给小而快的判定模型 Jev，38 个决策点各问一个有边界的问题，大模型只管干活。适合想看清、管住 Agent 每个决定的开发者。 亮点 每个决策点都能单独设成生效、只记录（shadow）或关闭，每次判定都写进本地账本，mu ledger 或桌面端的判定面板都能看。 判定模型可以换：托管的 Jev、本地运行的 322M 判定模型 Laya、任意分类模型或任意大模型，还能按决策点分别指定。没配 key 时用 OpenCode Zen 上的免费 Jev。 网页、搜索结果和 MCP 输出逐段过一遍提示注入筛查，冲着 AI 的那几段不进模型。 作者自己的实测：7 份真实的失败测试日志，按完全重复折叠，无损省下 51% 的字符；按目标让 Jev 挑测试日志，删掉 40% 到 46%，必需的行一行没丢。方法和局限都写在 README 里。 桌面端可以用 ChatGPT、Claude、Grok、Google 的订阅或 API key 登录，能导入 Claude Code 和 Codex 的对话接着做；内置浏览器由 Agent 一步一判地操作。 还在预发布阶段（0.1.x），作者每天在用。

CLI - 想脚本化批量操作，GUI 点不动；管 vSphere 又不想开浏览器 - ... **为了手感**。照着 `prlctl` 的命令风格写了一个，底层用统一的 Driver 接口把两种后端收进同一套命令里。 ## 快速感受 ```console $ vmctl list ┌────────────┬───────┬─────┬─────────┬─────────────┬──────────────────────────────────────┐ │ 名称 │ 状态 │ CPU │ 内存 │ 客户机系统 │ UUID │ ├────────────┼───────┼─────┼─────────┼─────────────┼──────────────────────────────────────┤ │ ubuntu-dev │ on │ 4 │ 8192 MB │ Ubuntu 24.04│ 564d1156-abcd-ef01-2345-678901234567 │ │ win11 │ off │ 8 │ 16384 MB│ Windows 11 │ 564d9876-2345-6789-abcd-ef0123456789 │ └────────────┴───────┴─────┴─────────┴─────────────┴──────────────────────────────────────┘ ``` ### 📊 基础信息 | 功能 / 命令语法 | 备注 | | --- | --- | | **列出所有虚拟机** `vmctl list` | 支持 --json 输出格式。 | | **查看虚拟机详情** `vmctl info ` | 显示名称、UUID 、Tools 状态、Guest IP 等。 | | **查看版本信息** `vmctl version` | 支持 --json 输出格式。 | ### 🔌 电源管理 | 功能 / 命令语法 | 备注 | | --- | --- | | **启动虚拟机** `vmctl start [--nogui]` | 返回即代表已加电，不等待 Guest OS 就绪。 | | **关闭虚拟机** `vmctl stop [--hard]` | --hard 表示强制断电。 | | **挂起虚拟机** `vmctl suspend ` | 暂停并保存当前状态到磁盘。 | | **恢复虚拟机** `vmctl resume ` | 恢复被挂起的虚拟机。 | | **暂停虚拟机** `vmctl pause ` | 暂停虚拟机运行（保持在内存中）。 | | **重启虚拟机** `vmctl reset [--hard]` | --hard 表示强制重启。 | ### 🔄 生命周期 | 功能 / 命令语法 | 备注 | | --- | --- | | **克隆虚拟机** `vmctl clone --name [--full] [--snapshot ] [--path ]` | 默认链接克隆；--full 为完整拷贝。vmrun 后端要求源 VM 已关机，vSphere 支持开机克隆。 | | **派生新虚拟机** `vmctl create --from [--memory 4096] [--cpus 4] [--full]` | 从现有 VM 派生（ vmrun 后端不支持从零创建裸 VM ）。 | | **修改虚拟机配置** `vmctl set --memory 4096 --cpus 4 [--name ]` | 必须在虚拟机已关机状态下执行。 | | **删除虚拟机** `vmctl delete ` | 删除虚拟机及其全部文件，不可恢复。 | ### 📸 快照管理 | 功能 / 命令语法 | 备注 | | --- | --- | | **列出快照** `vmctl snapshot list [--tree]` | --tree 可按树状结构展示快照关系。 | | **创建快照** `vmctl snapshot create ` | 为当前状态创建快照。 | | **删除快照** `vmctl snapshot delete [--children]` | --children 表示连同子快照一并删除。 | | **恢复快照** `vmctl snapshot revert ` | 必须在虚拟机已关机状态下执行。会一并恢复快照时的电源状态。 | ### 🖥️ Guest OS 交互 | 功能 / 命令语法 | 备注 | | --- | --- | | **执行 Guest 命令** `vmctl exec [-u root] -- ' '` | 经 /bin/sh 执行，捕获输出并透传退出码。要求 VM 已开机且安装 VMware Tools 。 | | **查看 Guest IP** `vmctl ip [--wait]` | 脚本友好，直接输出裸 IP 。要求安装 VMware Tools 。 | | **SSH 进入 Guest** `vmctl shell [--user u] [--port 22] [-i key] [--wait] [--dry-run]` | 要求 Guest 开启 sshd 。-- 之后的参数会透传给 ssh 命令（如 `vmctl shell -- -v`）。 | ## 特性 - **双后端一套命令**：默认 `vmrun`（本机 Fusion / Workstation ），`--backend vsphere` 直连 vCenter / ESXi （ govmomi ），本地和实验室环境切换只是换一个参数； - **VM 引用很随意**：显示名、名称的唯一子串、UUID 前缀、`.vmx` 路径、vSphere 的 MoRef （`vm-42`）都能用，不必先查 UUID ； - **同名快照消歧**：vmrun 按名字操作快照，撞名时给出 `名字#uid` 候选引用（走 Fusion 13.5+ 的 vmcli ）： - **guest 内执行**：`vmctl exec -- 'df -h'` 捕获输出并透传退出码，`vmctl shell ` 直接 SSH 进去（`--` 之后透传给 ssh ）； - **为脚本设计**： `--json` 全命令覆盖；退出码分级（ 0 成功 / 1 运行错误 / 2 用法错误 / 3 对象不存在 / 4 后端不支持，exec 再透传 guest 程序退出码）； - **中文界面**：帮助和报错默认中文，`--lang en` 切英文； shell 补全内置，VM 名是动态读当前后端列表补的； - **多 profile 配置**：`~/.config/vmctl/config.yaml` 里配好本地 + 远程两套环境，`--profile lab` 一条命令切换。 ## 技术栈与现状 Go + cobra + govmomi + go-pretty ，单二进制无运行时依赖，MIT 协议。 当前 0.x 阶段，还有一些问题尚未解决。但做好一个基础镜像后，后续的工作就好弄了。。。 - `vmrun` 后端不支持从零创建裸虚拟机（`create` 需要 `--from` 一个现有 VM ）； - vSphere 后端部分电源操作（如 `pause`）按设计返回「不支持」退出码 4 ，还在真机验证中； - exec / shell / ip 依赖 guest 内装有 VMware Tools （或开了 sshd ）。 ## 最后 写这个主要自用，但如果你也在 macOS 上折腾 VMware 、或者受够了 vmrun 的参数，欢迎来提 issue / PR ，特别是 vSphere 场景的真机反馈： https://github.com/normal-coder/vmctl Happy Hacking 🙌

projects.title: Show HN: Tofu – let your agent deploy full-stack apps
projects.summary: Hi HN, I'm the founder of Tofu, a code deployment platform built for agents. Paste our setup prompt to any agent you're already using and Tofu enables your agent to take your project from code to production. Current features include frontend & backend hosting (created & managed by Tofu), Postgres database (created & managed by Tofu), domain management (one-click setup for Cloudflare managed domains, manual DNS record for others), authentication, Google login, and Analytics. We built Tofu out of our personal frustrations: we're engineers who know how to code, we've deployed live products and understand the process, and our AI agents have already finished writing the code that works locally, yet taking a product fully online still took 2-3 hours: - Setup hosting, backend, database - Copy-pasting a lot of apikeys/secrets from here to there - Setting up correct redirect urls from places to places - Managing DNS records, domains - Setting up a lot services (email, 3rd parth OAuth, etc) - Payments Tofu works with any MCP-compatible agents, and here's a list of tested agents (10+ different projects end-to-end deployment via Tofu): local coding agents (Claude Code, Codex/ChatGPT, Kimi Code, DSH, Cursor), Instinct, Muse, Kimi Code cloud. None of that is hard, but each of these services have their own providers and it involves managing 5-10 different accounts. Most cloud providers have their own CLI, but it only works within their own platform and the process still involves a lot of manual interventions. Agents can call any API and use CLIs, but cannot open a Google Cloud project or put a card on file with 5 vendors. We think deployment is not a compute problem, but an accounts problem. Our endgoal is to utilize SSO across services, and provide agents the ability to deploy a live product end-to-end. We don't want to compete with any cloud providers, but to make agents actually capable of shipping "live" products. We're rolling out features to support buy domains directly from Tofu (we're an authorized reseller of Name.com), and provide more customizability to tech stacks. We're still very early and have just launched our product, please send us any feedbacks, comments, and we promise we will respond to every single one of them.

projects.summary: roomcomm 是一个开源的临时房间服务，专门为 AI 智能体设计。创建房间就得到一个链接，把链接发给别人的智能体（Claude、GPT、DeepSeek 或一段脚本），双方就在同一个对话里读写消息，房间的所有者在浏览器里旁观。不用注册账号，接入方式有 REST、MCP 和 A2A 三种。 亮点 一个房间就是一个 URL，不需要账号，也没有 SDK；房间 72 小时没人说话就自动过期。 同一个房间同时提供 REST、MCP（Streamable HTTP）和 A2A v1.0 接口，能发 HTTP 请求的智能体都能进来。 智能体名字可以随便填，所以每条消息还带 keyref，即发消息用的密钥的固定标识：同一个名字换了 keyref，就是换了人。 拿到房间链接的智能体不需要预装任何东西：页面里自带一份给智能体看的说明，Accept: text/markdown 直接返回纯 Markdown。 有言在先：房间内容对所有拿到链接的人公开、不加密，72 小时没人说话就过期，重要内容请自己留存。 网页界面支持简体中文；AGPL-3.0，Python + FastAPI，可以用 Docker 自己部署。

projects.title: Show HN: E2E – Open-source agentic testing framework for web, iOS and Android
projects.author: okwasniewski

github.name: tester-army/e2e
github.description: Next generation e2e testing framework for web and mobile apps.

projects.summary: Hey HN, I’m Oskar, one of the co-founders of TesterArmy. We built an agentic testing framework for web and mobile because traditional testing frameworks can’t keep up with the pace of how we build software today. e2e allows you to mix deterministic and agentic APIs in the same test. You can write the test cases using familiar APIs like `getByText()`or `getByTestId()` which you can also mix it with agentic `agent.act()`. The unique part about it is that e2e will cache and replay the agentic actions so you don’t have to pay for AI on each run. You can use it with any LLM, including subscriptions you are already paying for. On top of that, the core of e2e is platform agnostic. We ship both web and mobile engines out of the box; adding support for more platforms is pretty straightforward. Here’s a code short code snippet of an example test: ```ts import { test, expect } from 'e2e'; test('a member upgrades to Pro', async ({ app, agent, screen }) => { await app.open('/settings/billing'); await agent.act('upgrade the workspace to the Pro plan'); await agent.assert('the invoice preview shows a prorated amount'); await expect(screen.getByRole('status')).toContainText('Pro'); }); ``` Try it: npx e2e init GitHub: https://github.com/tester-army/e2e

projects.summary: Hi guys, Posted this ( https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48832797 ) on HN a few months ago when it was a different product (and closed source). It was originally a way of managing multiple agents in parallel (like TMUX, but with a nicer chat UI). But I found that I was only able to work with 3 or 4 agents simultaneously without information overload, so I decided to morph it into something which resembles Slack, where you can either privately speak to agents or address a room (like a channel) full of them. Importantly though, the agents can delegate work to each other, create other agents etc. Also had lots of user feedback from the first launch which means we've added multiple harnesses (Codex, OpenCode and waiting for Anthropic to approve Claude Code), git worktrees, connections to hundreds of MCPs, CLIs and APIs, browser-use and a proactive Chief of Staff (which periodically wakes up and gets things moving). projects.summary: 我做了一个开源版 workbuddy 替代品，你可能会问，类似的产品海了去了，重复造轮子有什么意义？ ![ScreenShot_2026-10-03_205453_642.png · 184]( https://img.cdn1.vip/i/6ac0fb3c7f690_1791032124.webp) # 缘起 事情是这样的 我在一家 AI 公司就职产品经理工作，就我用这个行业真实业务的视角，以及我接触到的一些东西来看我觉得他很有机会 公司业务说白了就是卖 token 而组成公司收入的主要客户实际上是搞蒸馏，这种客户我觉得并不优质 因为这不产生价值，是军备竞赛，一旦 AI 泡沫破灭，市场没有了钱，军备竞赛终止，公司业绩会大幅缩水，所带来的连锁反应是非常恐怖的 不过也在转型，在做企业客户，转型二字说来容易，赚钱真的是太难了，企业直客就两个特点，没钱、事多 企业用 AI 本身的目的就是为了降本增效，让他花大把的钱买 token 肯定要考虑是否值得 我们公司员工不限量使用任何大模型，成本价的情况下一个月最高的能用到五六千块 rmb ，平均使用也有 1500 左右，这个价格去企业里推，很少有公司愿意花这个钱来买 token 企业顶多能接受一个月一个坐席几百块的预算，甚至更低 一个蒸馏客户一天就能消费十几万 rmb ，而一个企业客户那，可能一个月才一两万，如果按这个来计算，这背后基础建设的投入想要回本需要拓展非常多的企业客户去平摊，也就是市场生产力需求真的爆发 大部分公司买 token 也不知道怎么用，你要跟他们讲 codex 、claudecode ，他们跟听天书一样，哪怕是程序员，大部分也都是只用过 trae 、qoder 等国产 vibecoding 应用，甚至还有的只用过豆包 这部分客户并非低端，只不过行业不同，对计算机技能接触深度不同，当然不能跟天天泡在电脑上的工作者相比 # workbuddy 的优劣势 企业更想要的是一套成熟的、高效的工作体系 所以他们大多对 workbuddy 评价是非常高的 因为都被腾讯的销售洗脑过很多次了，他们也表示 workbuddy 的业绩压力非常大，而且广发英雄贴让 fde 团队跟 workbuddy 合作一块进企业，这确实是一个共赢的合作 我参加的很多行业展会也接触到一些不同的需求，很多传统型的企业还是很看重数据安全的，他们更愿意自己私有化部署大模型，要求数据不出园区 使用自己部署的模型用来工作也需要一个能够接入的客户端，曾经这个客户端是 cherrystudio 再说一些 workbuddy 的问题吧 它最大的问题就是贵，我遇到的企业都说它好，但是又说它不好，原因就在于收费昂贵 买一个企业坐席是个人会员的两倍价格，积分还少一半，且积分非常不耐用，几个任务就没了，官方也没有说明积分的具体扣费逻辑，计费黑盒，不耐用，还贵 那么企业买了之后自定义 API 使用行不行？ 当然可以，但是 workbuddy 的自定义 API 只支持一个 openai completions 协议，像 anthropic 和 responses 协议就不支持了，而且他绑定了很多自己家模型才能使用到工具，自定义模型用不了 其实细数一些这个市场有哪些使用起来没有门槛的工具，还是挺有限的 所以我觉得这个市场还有机会，尤其是开源的 workbuddy 替代 他其实没啥门槛，护城河无非就是腾讯自家生态连接器，不给别家开放，但是办公领域有多少是用腾讯生态的？ workbuddy 这款产品定位本身就是腾讯在上一次企业办公应用全面惨败之后想要一雪前耻的东西 # 魔力工作台能做什么 dsh 本来很有希望的，但是门槛太高，把很多人拒之门外，所以我做了这款魔力工作台 像基础的 Agent 任务，PPT 制作、处理 word 、excel 、pdf 、整理文件等都是基本功 支持插件、skill 、角色库、mcp 、自定义模型三大常用协议 还支持 AI 视频生成、AI 生图、AI 剪辑等音视频方面的能力 用它来写代码也可以，我参考了 opencode 、omp 、开源版 claudecode 等编程 Agent 的核心能力，支持 LSP 、TUI 、git 工具等，可以识别语言自动安装所需的 LSP 服务 觉得有意思的话赏个 star 吧，我相信未来一定是属于开源的 https://github.com/ponysb/mlimli

projects.title: 开源 Bibo：成本极低，内置笔记、文件、任务和日历的 personal agent
projects.author: Peiiii
projects.summary: 我把 Bibo 开源了，MIT 协议。先说最想做好的三件事： 1. **成本极低。** 日常使用不需要常驻电脑，也不用一直开着 Linux 容器。只有需要运行代码时，才启动沙箱。 2. **内置个人管理工具。** 笔记、文件、任务和日历都有专门的界面。你可以直接查看、编辑和管理，也可以让 AI 来做。 3. **开源，可以自己部署。** 用自己的 Cloudflare 账号和模型 API Key ，数据存在自己的部署里，代码也可以自己改。 GitHub：[Peiiii/bibo]( https://github.com/Peiiii/bibo) 在线体验：[app.bibo.bot]( https://app.bibo.bot) 我希望它能成为每天都用得上的 personal agent 。想到什么可以随手记，需要做的事可以放进任务和日历，资料可以整理成文件；这些内容长期留着，之后还能接着用。 下面把界面都放出来。截图来自实际运行的 Bibo ，销售、订单和日程内容都是示例数据。 ### 概览 打开就能看到笔记、任务、日程和待处理信息。 ![Bibo 概览]( https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Peiiii/bibo/a121e9290c9da52646be4ebb546fd912f0b6b4e1/images/screenshots/v2ex-2026-10-04/bibo-overview.jpg) ### 对话 让 Bibo 阅读销售数据、总结重点，也可以让它继续整理报告和安排后续工作。 ![Bibo 对话与报告]( https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Peiiii/bibo/a121e9290c9da52646be4ebb546fd912f0b6b4e1/images/screenshots/v2ex-2026-10-04/bibo-chat.jpg) ### 笔记 笔记是可以直接编辑的 Markdown 文档。你自己写，或者让 Bibo 帮你整理，都能继续修改。 ![Bibo 笔记]( https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Peiiii/bibo/a121e9290c9da52646be4ebb546fd912f0b6b4e1/images/screenshots/v2ex-2026-10-04/bibo-notes.jpg) ### 文件 有独立的文件目录，可以打开、编辑文件。这里展示的是整理好的订单 CSV 。 ![Bibo 文件]( https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Peiiii/bibo/a121e9290c9da52646be4ebb546fd912f0b6b4e1/images/screenshots/v2ex-2026-10-04/bibo-files.jpg) ### 任务 任务有独立列表和详情，可以管理完成状态、优先级、描述和时间。分析出来的建议，可以接着变成待办。 ![Bibo 任务]( https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Peiiii/bibo/a121e9290c9da52646be4ebb546fd912f0b6b4e1/images/screenshots/v2ex-2026-10-04/bibo-tasks.jpg) ### 日历 日程直接显示在日历里，可以自己添加，也可以让 Bibo 帮你安排。 ![Bibo 日历]( https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Peiiii/bibo/a121e9290c9da52646be4ebb546fd912f0b6b4e1/images/screenshots/v2ex-2026-10-04/bibo-calendar.jpg) ### 收件箱 需要你关注和确认的内容放在这里，可以查看并标记处理。 ![Bibo 收件箱]( https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Peiiii/bibo/a121e9290c9da52646be4ebb546fd912f0b6b4e1/images/screenshots/v2ex-2026-10-04/bibo-inbox.jpg) ### 需要运行代码时，按需启动 Linux 沙箱 例如，用 Python 清洗订单表，去掉重复行，生成新的 CSV 和说明文档。下面这次演示实际运行了 Python ，文件已保存。 普通对话和个人管理功能由 Cloudflare Workers / Durable Objects 承载，文件保存在 R2 。需要运行 Python 、Shell 等代码时，才用 Cloudflare Sandbox ，不必为了日常使用维持一台常驻电脑。 ![Bibo 运行 Python 整理订单]( https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Peiiii/bibo/a121e9290c9da52646be4ebb546fd912f0b6b4e1/images/screenshots/bibo-sandbox-execution.png) ### 手机端 手机上也能继续对话、查看和管理任务。 ![Bibo 手机对话]( https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Peiiii/bibo/a121e9290c9da52646be4ebb546fd912f0b6b4e1/images/screenshots/bibo-mobile-chat.png) ![Bibo 手机任务]( https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Peiiii/bibo/a121e9290c9da52646be4ebb546fd912f0b6b4e1/images/screenshots/bibo-mobile-tasks.png) 自己部署需要 Cloudflare Workers Paid 、R2 、Sandbox 和模型 API Key ，具体步骤在仓库 README 。实际费用由模型调用、存储和沙箱使用量决定。 欢迎试用，也欢迎提 Issue 或 PR 。想听听大家：你最希望 personal agent 帮你处理哪件日常小事？

projects.author: mohitagw15856

github.description: 1166 professional Agent Skills for Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Cursor & Codex — PRDs, postmortems, leases, medical bills, layoffs, go-bags, new countries. Plain markdown, MIT, in Anthropic's plugin directory. Plus a typed decision layer: which skill, is it safe, ship or slip. Free in-browser or npx pm-claude-skills add.

projects.summary: 这是一个开源（MIT）的 Agent Skills 库，有一千两百多个技能。每个技能是一份 Markdown 文件，写明一件专业工作该怎么做：需要什么输入、按什么步骤、产出什么格式、交付前检查什么。装进 Claude Code、Trae、通义灵码等工具后，用中文提问就会自动匹配对应技能，比如写周报、准备晋升答辩、需求评审、估算经济补偿金。 亮点 不只是提示词合集：每个技能都有质量检查和反模式，并有自动化的结构检查和评测 有面向中文用户的技能包：职场（周报、晋升答辩、需求评审、飞书和钉钉格式）、考试与求职（申论、结构化面试、考研、校招）、生活事务（劳动合同、经济补偿金、个税汇算） 国内网络可用：npmmirror 安装、Gitee 镜像、魔搭社区的数据集和路由模型 附带 MCP 服务和浏览器 Playground，可以用自己的 DeepSeek、通义千问、Kimi、智谱 Key 直接运行

Build saved agents with skills and triggers. Connect 50+ tools. Review the diff, commit, push and open the PR in one place. Mac and Windows, free to start; Pro and Max add frontier models.

projects.title: [开源推荐] cliproxy-rs：让 Codex CLI 和 Claude Code 接上更多模型 API
projects.author: vayungodara

github.name: vayungodara/cliproxy-rs
github.description: Use DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, OpenRouter and more in Codex CLI and Claude Code: one local endpoint, API translation, failover. Single Rust binary, CLIProxyAPI-compatible.

projects.summary: cliproxy-rs 是用 Rust 写的本地代理。Codex CLI 现在只发 Responses 请求，而不少模型服务只提供 Chat Completions，比如 OpenCode Go 上的 DeepSeek、GLM、Kimi。代理在两者之间转换，工具调用也一起转换，Claude Code 的 Messages 请求同理。适合用自己的 API Key、想把多家模型放在一个地址后面的人。它是 CLIProxyAPI（Go）的 Rust 重写。（自荐：我是作者） 亮点 我实测过的是 Codex CLI 通过 OpenCode Go 上的 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 完成一个带文件编辑和 shell 命令的任务。直连 DeepSeek、Z.ai、Kimi 官方接口还没实测；这三家现在都原生支持 Responses，只用其中一家的话其实不需要这个代理。 多个 Key 或多家服务可以挂在同一个模型名下，某个 Key 返回 429 时，请求会换到下一个可用的。 单个二进制，控制台内置。启动 15 秒后的空闲内存约 25.8 MB，同样条件下 Go 版 CLIProxyAPI v8.0.35 是 49.7 MB。 不足也说清楚：和 CLIProxyAPI 只是部分对齐，docs/PARITY.md 里有具体数字；纯吞吐量上 Go 版更快。 MIT 协议，支持 macOS、Linux、Windows，可用一行脚本、Homebrew、Scoop 或 cargo 安装。

projects.title: [我的搜索-桌面版] 一款呼出搜索工具，支持网站/文本类/插件
projects.author: zhuangjie
projects.summary: ## 使用场景 项目开发最开始解决的问题是收藏了很多网站/软件/一些小教程(后面可能用到)，通过按规则写好源放到 github 上得到订阅然软件负责递归解析出数据项来搜索，有内置订阅，可制作自己订阅（[教程]( https://github.com/My-Search/my-search) | [官方源仓库-参考]( https://github.com/My-Search/official-subscribe)），桌面版有**插件功能** ![image]( https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/18476305640/typora@master/uploads/2026/10/03/1791035519022.png) ## 使用 **桌面版（订阅数据+插件）：基于 Rust 开发 [my-search-desktop]( https://github.com/My-Search/my-search-desktop)** 原版（订阅数据）：油猴脚本应用 [mysearch]( https://greasyfork.org/zh-CN/scripts/457020-%E6%88%91%E7%9A%84%E6%90%9C%E7%B4%A2) ## 当前有哪些可用的插件 | 插件名 | 描述 | |---|---| | Pi Agent | Pi 编码代理 - 支持多项目、多模型、模型配置面板、插件管理、流式对话与工具调用 | | 文件搜索 | 在粘贴/拖入的文件夹里按名称搜索文件：一直扫描、边扫边显示，随时可停止；回车或点击用系统默认程序打开 | | 插件市场 | 浏览、安装、更新与卸载插件 | | 录屏与水印 | 屏幕录制（可选实时叠加水印），并给已有视频批量添加文字/图片水印，支持九宫格定位与水印预设 | | 截图 | 全局快捷键截图：框选区域、标注后复制到剪贴板，并在前台查看最近 7 天的截图 | | MayeLite 快速启动 | 把常用文件/文件夹拖进来固定，随时一键打开；支持分类、排序与拖拽整理 | | 百度翻译 | 使用百度翻译 AI 能力，支持 200+ 语言互译，输入文本即译 | | GitHub 文件上传 | 将文件上传到 GitHub 仓库，支持拖拽、粘贴、选择文件与图片压缩 | | 剪贴板历史 | 自动记录你复制过的文本与图片，按快捷键呼出即可搜索、复制、删除、收藏。收藏的条目永久保留、不会被上限淘汰或清空。监听在后台原生完成，不干扰系统剪贴板。 | | 待办清单 | 本地待办清单：增删改查、优先级、标签、截止日期、筛选统计与 JSON 导出导入 | | 资源监控 | 每 5 秒采样整机 CPU / 内存 / 网络，按程序聚合，用可缩放时间范围的趋势图展示占用最高的 Top 10——快速定位 CPU 莫名 100%、内存暴涨、异常上传的程序 | 插件支持调整窗口大小，关闭自动恢复再打开时仍会按之前调试的宽度显示。 ## 如何开发新插件 AI 开发提示词： ``` 软件主体： https://github.com/My-Search/my-search-desktop 插件市场： https://github.com/My-Search/my-search-plugin-market 参考下面仓库开发出 my-search-desktop 插件。 需要开发插件的功能：xxx ``` 开发的插件通过设置里的挂载安装即可进行调试，当前开放的接口可能不多，需要可提 issues; 开发的插件可声明是否跟随软件启动，使用后退出是否后台运行，可声明在主体软件上快捷键使即使插件停止仍可通过快捷键激活插件功能； 插件市场运作说明： 插件都是在[插件市场 github 仓库]( https://github.com/My-Search/my-search-plugin-market)里定时自动索引的,按规范开发好，将仓库通过插件市场仓库提 issues 我看到会放到 index.json 会自动索引； ## 关于环境变量 用于多插件配置复用：通过直接在软件写好环境变量配置，在插件中直接通过环境变量授权给插件使用

projects.title: 【开源自荐】open-compute：开源的 Cloudflare Workers 兼容平台
projects.author: elliothux

github.name: elliothux/open-compute
github.description: Self-hosted Cloudflare Workers-compatible platform with Workers、KV、D1、R2、DO、Queues、Workflows、Cron、Cache、Images、Vectorize、AI Search、Artifacts、Static Assets、Service Bindings、Dynamic Workers、LogTail、Gateway in one Rust binary.

projects.summary: 阮老师好，自荐一下我做的 open-compute，一个可以运行在自己服务器上的 Cloudflare Workers 兼容平台，Apache-2.0 开源。 我是 Cloudflare 的粉丝，很喜欢 Workers 这套开发方式。不过我们做 B 端交付时，经常遇到客户因为数据安全要求、企业网络限制，需要把应用和数据留在自己的基础设施里。为了私有化，又得重新搭存储、队列、任务调度这些东西。所以我做了 open-compute，希望能把这套熟悉的开发体验带到客户内网。 它把运行时、部署、网关、存储、队列、工作流和管理界面打包进一个 Rust 二进制，底层使用 workerd，面向单机部署，默认使用 SQLite 和本地文件存储，不需要先搭一套 Kubernetes、外部数据库和缓存服务。 兼容是这个项目的重点：在支持范围内，现有 Cloudflare Workers 项目的业务代码一行都不用改，原来的 Wrangler 配置、Bindings 和框架适配器都能继续使用，切换部署目标即可运行。API 按 Cloudflare 的接口实现，已有的 SDK 和工具也可以复用。 目前支持 Workers、KV、D1、R2、Durable Objects、Queues、Workflows、Cron、Cache、Images、Vectorize、AI Search，以及 Static Assets、Service Bindings 等能力。具体支持范围和单机环境下的行为差异，可以查看产品矩阵。 我已经在一些 B 端客户的私有化环境里部署并跑了一段时间，也在实际交付中持续完善它。现在开源出来，欢迎有类似需求的朋友试用、反馈。 官网和文档：open-compute.dev

projects.title: Show HN: UseJunction – Find what your team's AI tools usage
projects.author: Dinuda
projects.summary: A few months ago, we started getting into the problem of actually seeing how our team's AI usage and its cost actually translates into a business outcome. We recently rolled out a public version open source after a few months of pilot testing the product. The product is UseJunction ( https://usejunction.dev ), and if your team is running multiple subscriptions/api from Cursor, Claude, Codex etc. this is for you to manage subscription spend, wastage and predictions. A bit of background, we had a team of 20 people running $200 Cursor subscriptions, and some were using a few others. That was over $4000 of spend. With this tool, we were able to get that to $2600 on our next billing cycle! That is a 35% decrease. We knew that people had to be facing this problem too, so we made it opensource for the community. All of these subscription providers leave behind telemetry on local machines, we use that to estimate usage. Soon we will be releasing a feature to attribute that spend to actual business outcomes that come from your project management tools. Currently considering actually adding a level of control on top of observability so that teams/orgs can actually govern AI tool usage.

projects.summary: I built a coding harness on top of the new Opencode v2, it started with the the idea of using the new jev model for routing easy tasks to cheaper models such as deepseek and hard tasks to models such as Opus 5.5. In total in separated it into 4 rungs - easy, medium, hard and frontier. Two more layers compound the savings: the Sol-Pi methodology based on the recently published paper which uses action fusion and observation packing and cuts roken usage within every tier. Doctrine injection loads your engineering standards into every session by default, so the agent writes code the way your team would. There is also a real control plane - escalation, permission and verification hooks so the agent surfaces uncertainty instead of being confidently wrong in silence. Run it using your own key from Openrouter or Vercel AI gateway key, we need this since one key is able to call the jev decision model as well as the llms for coding. One more thing I added was the ability to connect your Meta Muse to use this for coding tasks which has worked really well so far you can try it out by copying the promp for agent on the website. Two ways you can use it today is the Mac app and the cli. Honest limitations are documented, happy to take any questions. Repo: https://github.com/grist-ai/grist npm CLI: npm install -g grist-ai

projects.title: Show HN: Breadcrumb, record everything on your mac + context manager for AI
projects.author: jv22222
projects.summary: Hi HN, I'm Justin. Breadcrumb records everything you do on your Mac (screen + meetings + AI transcripts + what you and your AI decided) and turns it into memory your AI can search. It's local and encrypted. You can also teach it rules by talking to it and it makes sure the right rules turn up in the right context. Works with Claude Code / Codex / Cursor / opencode. All of this is exposed to your AI as 30+ MCP tools (here's the definitions): https://innerloop.works/breadcrumb/mcp I started it in June because I wanted to understand what was going on with my AI dev work. Then it just kept growing as I jammed on it 10 hours a day for 3 months. I started by recording every screen so I could jump back to a moment and see what I'd been doing with the AI. Then I added MCP so the AI could search it. Then time tracking. Then meetings with transcripts and timestamped screenshots. After that I started feeding the data back in. At first it was just a few relevant memories in the prompt. Then I started adding rules and rules modules. Then I started recording the AI transcripts and all the other stuff the AI did (subagents, tools etc). I wanted a complete record so I could go back and see what the AI did and why. I found the more data the AI had the more useful it became. One example. I got off a zoom call with the team at the day job and said: "Review the meeting I just had, find all the bugs we discussed, and create JIRA tickets with screenshots." It read the transcript. Found every bug we mentioned, pulled the screens from the screen timeline, spun up my local server, diagnosed each bug, reviewed the code, created 14 tickets in JIRA with diagnosis and likely fixes, attached 12 screenshots as evidence, and created a nice Slack message to send to my colleagues. I never built a workflow for any of that. Claude had the meeting record, Breadcrumb tools, and rules I'd accumulated. It basically chained the steps together itself. My favorite thing about the system is observability of my own work as an AI developer. I can trace a bug all the way back to the first thing I said (or the first thing the AI did) that caused it. Then I can add a rule so it doesn't happen again. Anyway, my working system is simply Claude Desktop + Breadcrumb + Markdown. I find I don't need anything else. It's local software for one person. Local models for transcription and diarization. Data encrypted with SQLCipher and a passphrase. You can exclude any apps, websites, words and phrases. Breadcrumb itself only makes one network call which is a daily update check. (but of course your AI will use it and that is local or cloud depending on what you use). It runs cool about 12% of one core on average (M series mac has 8+). You can set it to just save OCR text or to save screenshots. If just OCR it's about 12mb day (a lot of telemetry, indexing etc). If you record screenshots on meetings it's about 120mb/hour (1 every 2 secs). It can also record screenshots of everything that's heavy at about 160mb/day. It does local classification/naming with ollama with Gemma 3 4B (2.5 GB). It's 100% free. There's no account you can just download and start using it. I'll monetize it via E2EE cloud sync and team sync. It's open beta. Just one developer working on it. Requires 16GB+ M Series Mac. Thanks for reading! https://innerloop.works/breadcrumb (homepage) https://innerloop.works/breadcrumb/download (direct download) https://innerloop.works/breadcrumb/mcp (mcp definition)

projects.title: Show HN: Silta: family assistant on Matrix with continuity across context limits
projects.author: dmitry-markin
projects.summary: Silta is a self-hosted assistant serving multiple users from a single Matrix account, used by me, family, and close friends for the last three weeks. It runs on Claude Code with each person using their own Claude subscription. Silta answers everyday questions, conducts web research (presenting the results as PDFs), performs scheduled tasks to monitor/research something and notify you if needed. It uses a deliberate handoff & compaction procedure, writing the compaction summary itself with a custom prompt, so the thread of the conversation and its picture of the user is preserved across context limits. As it turned out, the assistant accessible in a continuous chat (contrary to ChatGPT / Claude Web sessions) builds up better context about you and your tasks, and provides more relevant answers and help. It runs on Claude Code as the only allowed way to use a personal Claude subscription. Using Claude Code also spares me developing a harness, at the cost of tracking changes as new versions of Claude Code are released. The assistant itself (the daemon, the channel plugin, the supervisor, and the deployment) is open-source, while the model and the harness are Anthropic's and proprietary. Silta is deployed to a dedicated VM with separate Linux users per session and systemd hardening, protecting sessions from each other. Claude Code's bubblewrap sandbox is used to protect the Claude credential and the harness's state from the agent. This does not protect from prompt injections coming from search results and potentially leaking user data. Matrix E2EE protects the conversation from a Matrix server operator, but everything in the context is of course sent to the model provider. Private content is never logged, and the operator is expected to respect the privacy and not read the session transcripts on disk. Additionally, it is recommended to use full-disk encryption and tell the users how their data is handled. Silta only works in its workspace with files explicitly shared by users in the chat. Giving it access to a user's own computer or services like email is not planned. Since Opus 5.5 has been released, it is possible to run a session on a $20 Claude Pro subscription. Before that, only Fable 5.1 was pleasant enough to talk to. When run on Anthropic API, a moderately used session extrapolates to $100-$150 per month, with each research run costing $6-$12. Silta is built with Claude Code and Silta itself. The design, review, deployment, and testing are mine.

projects.title: Show HN: Beyond "chat with your database" – agentic data exploration
projects.author: sandhya6
projects.summary: Business intelligence is changing. AI can now do more than turn a question into a single SQL query: it can investigate a question through a series of queries, examining the result of one query to decide what to query next. Today, to answer a business question against a database, analysts use a tool like Tableau: they select relevant data, build an initial view using fields, filters, calculations, and visualizations, then look for patterns or anomalies. They form hypotheses and test them — filtering by region, drilling into customer cohorts, comparing time periods, or creating calculations to validate or rule out an explanation. They repeat this process until the evidence supports an answer, then save a workbook or dashboard for others to review and monitor. With a single question, AI can now perform much of this exploratory loop: it can investigate the data, follow the evidence through multiple queries, and present the supporting analysis. This is agentic data analysis — AI autonomously decides what to investigate next based on the results it has already found. Reportr puts agentic AI at the center of the experience, then builds complementary capabilities around it to address AI's limitations: SEMANTIC LAYER Production databases are rarely clean: columns that are no longer used, cryptic names like status2, misc, or flag, columns whose meaning has quietly shifted over time, tables that linger long after their purpose is gone, and so on. This is known as schema rot. AI tools guess wrong against schemas like this. Reportr's semantic layer lets you give tables and columns business-friendly names and descriptions, document relationships, capture business rules, and flag what AI should ignore — so it's working from what your data means, not just what it's called. USER OVERSIGHT AI-generated answers can be wrong. Reportr lets you inspect the SQL executed to arrive at an answer. It also provides explanations of what the SQL does (understandable by business users), and how it works (intended for technical users). You can review the analysis rather than simply accepting AI's conclusions. BETTER USER EXPERIENCE Reportr UI is specifically optimized for chatting with a database. Database queries often return large number of records. Ask which customers haven't placed an order in the last 90 days, and the answer is a list of customers. Reportr displays tabular data in an interactive grid that can handle thousand of records without breaking a sweat. The grid supports sorting, searching, and filtering. REPORTS AND DASHBOARDS Chat is ephemeral. Every conversation starts fresh, and that's fine for exploration — but not for information you need every week. When a chart or table reveals something worth tracking, save it as a report. Combine reports into dashboards to monitor changes over time, share findings, and keep important insights accessible without having to ask the same questions again. ROLE BASED ACCESS CONTROL Not everyone on your team needs the same level of access. Reportr's role-based access control lets you give each user exactly the permissions they need — from view-only access to report building, database management, and full administrative control. CENTRALIZED MANAGEMENT Reportr is a web application — there's nothing to install, nothing to update, and no desktop app to manage across your team. Database connection strings, AI keys, are all managed centrally. Reportr can connect to all supported databases directly, MCP servers and drivers are not needed. INSTALL ON-PREMISE Reportr can be self-hosted on your own infrastructure, ensuring your data never touches our servers. You can supply your own AI API key. Your data will not be used for training AI models. If you use Claude on AWS Bedrock, Amazon additionally guarantees that your data is never stored or used for training — and Bedrock is HIPAA eligible. GIVE IT A WHIRL Visit https://reportr.com to give it a try. We look forward to getting your feedback. Reportr is easy to try: you can provision a sample database with the press of a button and start asking questions right away. Or connect your own database and analyze your own data. You can ask up to five questions for free.

projects.title: 分享一个开源的本机 AI 网关：中转、国产模型、Claude Code、Codex 放在一起管，每个请求花了多少钱都看得到
projects.author: Faz
projects.summary: 先说适合谁：同时用 Claude Code 、Codex ，手上有好几个中转或国产模型的 key ，被 CC Switch 切换折腾过的，可以试试。 ![概览]( https://thinkwat.ch/lite/overview.webp) ## 之前用 CC Switch 的几个痛点 - **切上游总要重启客户端。（ proxy 模式也没有特别好用）** - **Codex 初始化时输入的 key 被它学了过去，结果上游直接炸了。（好像最近修了）** - **Codex 换了供应商，旧会话就接不上**（[#7257]( https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/7257)，四十多楼，还开着）。 - **路由弱，切换也不方便。** 一个客户端同时只能用一个供应商；按模型分给不同家（[#3703]( https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/3703)）挂了快四个月没有维护者回复；负载均衡标了不做，理由是会丢缓存（[#842]( https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/842)）；按供应商单独设代理，3.14 起还被去掉了（[#2243]( https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/2243)）。 - **设计和产品力差。** 界面不好看，交互也乱。功能越堆越多：十个客户端、MCP 、Skills 、提示词、会话、用量、几十个供应商预设（里面还有赞助商），核心的切换和路由反而没做好。 - **中转能看到你发出去的全部内容**，它发出前不做任何检查（[#7357]( https://github.com/farion1231/cc-switch/issues/7357) 还开着）。 ## 换成 ThinkWatch Lite 之后 思路不一样：客户端只接一次，指向本机的网关，之后的事都在网关里做。 - **切中转不用重启**：换上游、调路由都在网关里完成，客户端的配置不再动。手动选择的策略组在菜单栏或托盘里就能切。 - **配置只写一次**：接管时只改指向网关的那几项，写之前给完整 diff 、备份原文件，随时能还原。客户端只拿到一把网关专用的 key ，原来的 key 和登录信息不会被导入或拿去用。 - **Codex 会话不再拆开**：Codex 只认一个 provider ，换上游不影响会话列表（接管前的旧会话仍在原来那边）。 - **路由够用**：按模型、token 数、工具、图片、思考等条件分给不同的上游，也能改写模型名；故障转移、轮询、延迟最低、费用最低都有。轮询时同一个会话固定在同一个上游，缓存照常命中。 - **什么格式都能接**：Anthropic 、OpenAI Chat 、Responses 、Gemini 四种格式互相转换。Claude Code 能用 GPT 、Gemini ，Codex 能接只有 Chat 接口的中转。 - **每个请求看得清**：费用、token 、缓存命中、首 token 时间、生成速度，走了哪条规则、依次试了哪几个上游，完整的请求和响应都在。中转可以按倍率计价，请求还能重放到另一个上游对照。菜单栏直接显示今天花了多少，GLM Coding Plan 、ChatGPT 的额度也能看。 - **省套餐额度**：Claude Code 自己发的标题生成、预热这类辅助请求，可以由网关本地应答，不发给上游。 - **中转收不到你的 key**：发出前把 API key 、token 、私钥等换成占位符，响应里回显时再换回来；模型让客户端执行「下载后执行」「外发环境变量」这类命令时，在流式输出中途切断。默认只记录、不拦截，看过日志确认没有误报再打开。 一键接管的客户端：Claude Code 、Codex （包括 ChatGPT 桌面版里的 Codex ）、opencode 、Claude Desktop 、Zed 、Aider 、DeepSeek Harness ； Cursor 、Continue 、Antigravity CLI 有手动配置的说明。Windows 上 WSL 里的 Claude Code 、Codex 也能接（ WSL 1 或 mirrored 网络）。网关还能装在 Linux 服务器上，由桌面端远程管理。 ![流量]( https://thinkwat.ch/lite/traffic.webp) ## 安装 - macOS （ Apple 芯片）：`brew install --cask thinkwatchproject/tap/thinkwatch-lite` - Linux：`curl -fsSL https://github.com/ThinkWatchProject/ThinkWatch-Lite/releases/latest/download/install.sh | sh` - Windows （ x64 、ARM64 ）： https://thinkwat.ch/zh-CN/lite/#install GitHub： https://github.com/ThinkWatchProject/ThinkWatch-Lite （ MIT ，数据都在本机，不收集使用数据） 用着有问题，或者想要哪个客户端、上游，欢迎在楼里说。

projects.title: Show HN: Groundtrack – Continual learning for coding agents
projects.author: reybahl
projects.summary: Hi HN! I built Groundtrack to help coding agents continuously learn and improve from their work across a company. With coding agents handling most of code implementation, a lot of things like review corrections, failed approaches, and discovered constraints stay trapped in individual agent sessions, so future agents can repeat the same failures. Sometimes a broken or agent-unfriendly tool or workflow can cause those issues too; if multiple agents independently find workarounds, those failures don’t get connected and aren’t used to improve the system around the agents. Groundtrack turns those learnings into scoped and shared engineering experiences that can help future agents across teams working with Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, and OpenCode. It retrieves relevant lessons during later work, records whether they helped, and updates or supersedes knowledge as it learns over time. It also identifies recurring friction that shouldn’t just become another stored experience. If agents repeatedly struggle with the same tool or workflow, Groundtrack creates an evidence-backed draft initiative so the team can fix the underlying environment and prevent a certain class of mistake systemically. For example, on the landing page, I follow a database migration incident through the entire loop. Groundtrack turned the original workaround into a scoped experience, surfaced it when a later agent encountered similar migration drift, and recorded that it was successfully applied. After connecting evidence from seven sessions, it also proposed making the safe migration workflow a permanent part of the engineering environment and prevent the issue altogether. There have been many challenges I’ve already run into to make this helpful (and still many unsolved things!), one of which has been generalizing and determining the applicability of one lesson to another session. I wrote about some of my retrieval experiments here: https://groundtrack.dev/blog/retrieving-knowledge-that-appli... It’s an early product and I’d really love any and all feedback I can get. If you or your team regularly use coding agents, please try it on an active project and see if it helps your agents learn and improve over time. It’s free for solo use.

projects.title: Show HN: Caffold – The same agent workspace on desktop, foldable, tablet, phone
projects.author: taehoon
projects.summary: Hello, Caffold is an open-source, self-hosted workspace for coding agents. You can continue the same work across desktop, foldable, tablet, and phone. I started building it for myself in late June. It was initially only for Codex. I got a Galaxy Z Fold8 in early August and started using Caffold much more seriously. By late August, I had moved my existing Codex work into Caffold too. I've been doing all of my development work in Caffold since then. After about a month of that, it finally feels ready to share. For now, it supports the three agents I actually use day to day: Codex, Claude Code, and Grok. The idea came from how my work had changed. Coding agents now write almost all of the code. I spend most of my time reading code and diffs, watching what the agents are doing, steer them when needed, and give the next instruction. When I saw the upcoming Fold8, its unfolded screen looked large enough for this kind of work. I rarely need to type code myself. I often enter prompts by voice as well as with a keyboard. So I started wondering if a foldable could be my main interface for development rather than just a secondary device. I also wanted to see how far I could go with the browser platform itself. The frontend is plain JavaScript and CSS. It uses Web Components and native ES modules. There is no TypeScript, React/Vue/Svelte, or bundler. (That doesn't mean I avoid external libraries entirely. I use things like xterm.js and pdf.js where they make sense.) I'm also curious how many people will want to use foldables this way, especially now that devices like the iPhone Duo are coming too.

projects.summary: OrbCue 是 Windows 桌面上的一颗悬浮小球，解决的是人在盯着多agent进度时总要专注或者不断"上下文切换"来轮询不同会话的进度的问题，它替你盯着 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Grok Build等命令行 Agent。它利用hook把轮询优化为中断逻辑，把 Windows 和WSL 里的所有会话汇总在一起：谁在工作、谁在等你、谁做完了一眼可见，还会弹通知或推送到手机，点一下就能跳回对应终端。 适合同时跑多个 Agent、或者挂着长任务去做别的事的时候用。项目用 Rust 和 Tauri 2 开发，界面基于Svelte，只读取工具自带的 hook 事件，不读对话内容。 功能： • 状态汇总：所有 Agent 会话汇总到同一颗球上，显示工作中、等待输入、等待授权、完成、失败。 • 多工具接入：支持 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor CLI、Grok Build，装在 Windows 或 WSL 里的都能接入，其他工具也可以通过命令自行接入。 • 提醒：弹系统通知并响提示音，可选通过 ntfy 推送到手机。 • 跳回终端：点一下回到对应终端。用 orb run 或"原命令启动"开的会话，能精确跳到那个标签页。 • 一键连接：自动发现已安装的工具，一键写入 hook，改之前自动备份，断开时只撤掉自己写的部分。 • 隐私：只读取 hook 事件，不读对话内容，数据只留在本机。 • 小球交互：可以贴边收起、调透明度，支持全局快捷键、开机自启和多套主题。

projects.title: dsh 插件 dsh-waker：唤醒专属你的 AI 员工
projects.author: SFLYYQ
projects.summary: # dsh-waker dsh 插件把 IM 变成 DSH 数字员工的唤醒入口：在群里 @机器人 说一句需求，任务就自动执行并把结果发回群里。 项目地址： ## 功能 - **@机器人 即派活**：群聊 @机器人（或单聊直接发），消息自动交给 DSH 执行，结果自动回 IM - **多角色 Waker**：可创建多个不同职能的数字员工（如全栈开发、测试），发消息时自动匹配最合适的一个 - **项目隔离**：每个 Waker 只能访问授权给它的项目，越权写入被沙箱拒绝 - **任务看板**：排队中 / 运行中 / 需要操作 / 失败 / 已取消 / 已完成，可筛选、取消、重试 - **排队与并发**：同时最多跑 N 个任务（默认 2 ），超限自动排队 ## 解决什么问题 - **人必须在电脑前盯会话**：现在 IM 发条消息就能远程派活，手机上也能用 - **执行过程是黑盒**：任务看板实时展示状态，等待审批时标记「需要操作」，点进去就能处理 - **任务执行到一半卡在提问上**：Waker 有疑问时会把问题转到 IM 群里，你回复后它继续跑 - **对话上下文混乱**：同一群每天一个会话窗口，上下文延续；发「新任务： 」强制开新任务 ## 怎么使用 ### 1. 创建 IM 机器人（一次性） 1. 登录 [IM 开放平台]( https://open-dev.dingtalk.com/) → 应用开发 → 创建企业内部应用 2. 应用能力 → 添加「机器人」能力，接收消息模式选 **Stream 模式**（无需公网） 3. 应用凭证页拿到 **Client ID （ AppKey ）** 和 **Client Secret （ AppSecret ）**，发布应用版本 4. 把机器人拉进群聊（或直接单聊） ### 2. 安装插件 ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/SFLAQiu/dsh-waker.git ``` 若提示 `blocked build`，把 CLI 打印的键加进 `~/.dsh/profiles/web/pnpm-workspace.yaml` 后重跑： ```yaml allowBuilds: dsh-waker: true ``` 然后重启 `dsh web` 并强刷浏览器（⌘⇧R ）。npm 包发布后也可用 `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-waker`。 ### 3. 配置并使用 1. DSH 设置 → Waker → IM 管理：填入 Client ID 和 Client Secret →「保存并应用」，状态变「已连接」 2. DSH 设置 → Waker：配置 Waker （职能、头像）、项目（本地路径或 Git 仓库）、 @Waker 绑定 3. Waker 详情 →「能力」页签：按职能从全局目录选用 MCP 工具与技能（支持搜索过滤与全选/清空/全量批量操作；不配置 = 继承全量，详见 [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md) 能力治理机制） 4. 群里 @机器人 + 任务描述，例如： > @机器人 帮我看看当前仓库的结构 - 机器人秒回「收到了」，随后按任务类型执行，完成后回执结果 - 追问直接继续 @，上下文延续；`新任务： ` 强制新建 - 群聊没 @ 机器人时完全静默，不会打扰

projects.summary: 我们组 4 个人凑钱买的订阅，之前一直用 sub2api 。用了小半年，功能没得说，但每次服务器要迁移我就头疼——除了它自己，还得把 Postgres 和 Redis 一起搬过去。有次 Redis 挂了，整个网关直接不工作，排查了半天发现是内存超了。 后来想想我们其实就 4 个人，用不着这么重的东西。就自己写了一个，叫 SubLane ，一个轻量级的，专供于小团队的订阅 / API 共享的 API 网关。 ## 它是干嘛的 把订阅账号接进来，给每个人发一把自己的 key ，大家拿 key 去用，我在后台能看到谁用了多少。 就这样。没有别的。 装完是一个 Docker 容器，数据库直接跑在进程里，没有 Redis ，前端编译进同一个二进制文件。备份就是备份那个数据卷。 技术上是 Go + chi + sqlc ，SQLite 存数据，前端 React 19 编译进二进制。上游用了 CLIProxyAPI 的 executor ，但 OAuth 、凭据加密、账号选择这些都是自己写的，凭据不放进 SDK 的管理器。 开源地址： https://github.com/murongg/SubLane 大家有什么痛点或者需求都可以提 issue ，合理的我会尽可能的满足 ![软件截图]( https://i.v2ex.co/c2WL81x5.png)

projects.title: Show HN: Open-source skills for end-to-end video ad campaigns
projects.author: sayonidroy

github.name: SupercmoHQ/superCMO-skills
github.description: Open-source skills that empower any AI agent (Claude, Cursor, Hermes, etc.) to generate end-to-end marketing campaigns - UGC videos, ad videos, product photography and more.

projects.summary: Hey there! We are building SuperCMO Skills, open source tools which allow agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, etc.) to research, plan and create video and image campaigns end-to-end right out of your terminal or IDE. We got tired of paying for expensive AI subscriptions and wasting countless hours assembling a pipeline for just one video ad, so we created these tools for ourselves. SuperCMO integrates with your agents to provide the ability to plan, shoot, edit, and stitch complete campaigns. We began with simple prompt wrappers but soon realized the need to rethink our entire pipeline to overcome common limitations of the AI video. - Pipeline Orchestration: Creating one ad now requires jumping through several apps: writing scripts in one, creating images in another, recording audio in yet another, and stitching the whole thing in an editor. SuperCMO does all of that natively. The tool knows how to choose the appropriate model (like automatically switching prompts for Veo versus Seedance) and do the whole post-production, including trimming and voiceover synchronization. - Consistency from Shot to Shot: In true AI video generators, products and actors continually transform from shot to shot. We solved that problem by storyboarding before rendering and locking in master reference images in every generation. - Directional Control: Completely automated agents often go awry creatively. So, we've developed the capabilities to take a peek at every stage of the process. You're always in control, approving the creator, the story idea, and the script before anything is expensively rendered. People are using this today to create UGC product ads (give the agent a product photo and it chooses the creator, generates the script, and creates a ready MP4 file) or to analyze competitors' work (agent analyzes the winning advertisement from the competitor and recreates it with your product in mind). This project will be released under an Apache-2.0 license. You can come to us with your own vendor keys to have everything done for free or to generate using our keys and just pay for each usage without any lock-in. Thank you for your attention!

projects.title: Show HN: HN.watch – Videos of all Hacker News posts
projects.author: mrborgen
projects.summary: Hi HN, I’m Per, founder of Scrimba (YC S20). We’ve spent the last decade teaching people how to code with an HTML-based video format. We’ve now plugged an LLM into it, so that people can create explainer videos about anything. It’s called “Scrimba Explain”. To demo this technology for Hacker News, we built HN.watch. It’s like HN, but with explainer videos instead of articles. We create them on-the-fly the first time someone clicks on a link. While there are obvious visual drawbacks of using HTML instead of diffusion models, there are three big benefits: - Speed: Much faster to generate than pixel-based videos (just a few seconds from click to playback) - Cost: Our cost per video is ~$0.04. (Excluding image generation, which some videos utilize. Quickly blows up the cost) - Easy editing: the above benefits also make AI-assisted editing cheap & fast Our hypothesis is that if video creation goes from “dollars and minutes” to “cents and seconds”, a bunch of new use cases will be unlocked. Here are some we see already: - A video explanation of every single Pull Request (we do this internally) - Give every page in your internal/extrernal docs a video - Turn a complex article into a video in ~4 seconds (via our Chrome extension) - Course creators can quickly draft lessons before recording the real thing - People also create a lot of personal stuff stories for their kids, wedding invitations, birthdays, etc The stack is based on an open-source programming language (Imba) created by our CTO, Sindre Aarsæther. It compiles to JavaScript, so it interoperates fully with the npm + node ecosystem. You can learn more here: https://imba.io/ We’ve also built our own sync engine (OP), and a context management system for agents (Q). We feared this would make the LLMs struggle when writing code for us, as neither is in their training data (there’s very little Imba in there too). However, we’ve been pleasantly surprised to see that LLMs actually are really good at our stack. This is probably because the stack is extremely dense. Imba is compact, and so is OP, where a single declaration sets storage, sync, permissions, UI, and what the AI sees. This means there’s no translations between frontend, API, db and JSON where the model can get confused and get things wrong. Simply said, instead of using React.js, Express, Supabase, and LangChain, we built it all from scratch. Definitely suffering from the “not invented here” syndrome, lol! As for the models, we use Gemini, GPTs, Inworld, ElevenLabs, and a few others. If you want to try it out, just take your pick: - The Web UI (scrimba.com/explain) - MCP (add it to your coding agent) - ChatGPT Plugin - Chrome Extension You can find a link to all of the above in our docs: https://docs.scrimba.com/explain/introduction And finally, a real pixel-based video of the tool: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=k6rbHmBxSEs Would love to hear your feedback and if anyone has ideas for other use cases. PS: I expect quite a bit of pushback from HN for this launch, given how fan of text the HN crowd is. This kind of tool is not for everyone. But there are a lot of people today who prefer videos over text, especially in the younger generations.

projects.title: 【开源自荐】seiso：给 AI 写的项目文档做 lint，查出对话残留、过时版本号和失效链接
projects.author: scarletkc

github.name: scarletkc/seiso
github.description: A Markdown convention and linter for project docs written by AI and read by humans and agents

projects.summary: 现在项目里的 Markdown 文档越来越多是 AI 写的，写的速度远远快过人审的速度。更麻烦的是，Claude Code、Codex 这类 coding agent 在下一次改代码时，又会把这些文档当成上下文读回去。文档里一个过时的版本号，或者一份字段列表在三处副本里只改了一处，人会被误导，agent 也会照着错的继续改。而且 AI 写文档，翻来覆去犯的就是那几种错。 seiso 是一套项目文档的 Markdown 约定，加上按这套约定做检查的 linter，用 Rust 写的。思路类似 rustfmt 统一了 Rust 的代码格式，各个项目共用同一套规则，不用每家自己重新商量。项目要做的主要是把自己的文档对应到类型上，seiso init 会给出一份初始配置。 约定的核心是这几条。 每篇文档声明一种类型，比如 howto、reference、adr，只写这种类型该写的内容。操作指南只给步骤，为什么这样设计放进 ADR。 每个事实只有一个归属页面，其他页面链接过去，不再复述一遍。 长期存在的页面不记录比页面本身变得更快的值，比如版本号、部署状态和数量。 成稿不对提需求的人说话，也不交代自己是怎么写出来的。 工具判断不了的例外要写明理由，没写理由的例外本身就算违规。 下面是对一篇中文部署文档的实际检查结果： text $ seiso check --preview docs/deploy.md:7:7: VOX001 This phrase refers to the requester of an earlier conversation. | 7 | 好的，下面是按你的要求更新后的部署指南。 | = suggestion: State the document's instructions or facts directly for its readers. docs/deploy.md:9:12: STL001 This sentence pairs a current-state marker with a value that can change. | 9 | 当前生产环境运行的是 2.3.1 版本。 | = suggestion: Link to the source that owns the value, or state a lasting requirement with its constraint. docs/deploy.md:14:5: LNK001 Local link target "config.md" does not exist in the workspace. | 14 | 配置项见配置说明。 | = suggestion: Update the path or restore the target; paths resolve from this document's directory, or from the workspace root when they start with /, and seiso does not add .md or index.md. Found 3 diagnostics. 每条诊断都会给出位置和修改建议，agent 只看 seiso 的输出就能修掉大部分问题。遇到需要人来判断的情况，比如两个页面到底哪个拥有某个事实，诊断会直接点出要做的决定。seiso 不去猜一段话像不像机器写的，格式和拼写也留给其他工具。 我对误报比较保守。新规则一律先进 preview，要在固定版本的真实仓库语料上攒够至少 100 条逐条人工复核的留出集诊断，精度达到 95% 以上，才会升级成默认启用的稳定规则。所以现在默认只跑文档类型声明、本地链接目标和抑制注释这几条稳定规则，上面例子里的对话残留和当前状态值检查还在 preview，要加 --preview 才会开启。宁可漏报，也不给没有依据的诊断。 它可以接进 Claude Code 的 PostToolUse hook。agent 每次用 Write 或 Edit 改完一个 Markdown 文件，seiso 就检查这个文件，发现问题时用退出码 2 把诊断直接反馈给 Claude，让它当场修掉。另外也支持 pre-commit 和 CI。中文、英文和日文文档都能检查。 sh 三种安装方式任选一种 cargo install seiso uv tool install seiso # 或 pipx install seiso npm install -g @scarletkc/seiso 在仓库根目录 seiso init seiso check PyPI 和 npm 包自带主流平台的预编译二进制，不需要装 Rust 工具链。MIT 协议。

projects.title: Show HN: ParkourNote – A research workspace, built solo in a month with Claude
projects.author: sushiwang
projects.summary: Hi HN, I'm sushi. I built ParkourNote, a personal knowledge management app that currently focuses on research: finding papers, reading PDFs, asking AI about them, and writing. A few things it does: Describe a topic, and an agent creates a project, searches arXiv, and imports relevant papers The PDF reader previews citations on hover, overlays translations on the page, and shows original and translated text side by side The agent sees the page you're reading and your selection; you can also connect Claude or ChatGPT via MCP A block editor with math support that compiles LaTeX / Typst to PDF Demo (7 min): https://youtu.be/yZs2nQJtgkg ParkourNote is just me. I built it in about a month: the web app, a Flutter mobile app, and a Chrome extension. It isn't even my full-time job. I work on it for an hour or two in the morning before work, plus evenings and weekends. Two things surprised me along the way: - The web app uses BlockNote for Notion-style editing, but I wanted Flutter for mobile. I asked Claude to implement a compatible editor in Flutter. It took about a day, and it works: documents round-trip between web and mobile. - In high school I worked as a video editor for MarginNote. Back then, a single 5-minute video took about a month, from scripting to recording, editing, and animation. For ParkourNote, I made launch videos for the Chinese, English, Japanese, and Korean markets in one weekend, plus a second Chinese version cut for portrait viewing. I didn't open a video editor once. It was all done with Claude Opus 5.5. PG recently posted something along the lines of: in the AI era, you want to be either very close to the users or very close to the intelligence. That resonated with me, but honestly, building this left me a bit lost. I find it hard to think of a consumer software feature that current AI can't build. So if anyone can build anything, where is the moat? I'm genuinely unsure. The other side of it is exciting, though. Running ParkourNote alone, I feel less like a solo developer and more like a CEO of a small company: I manage product, engineering, marketing, and operations, and somehow it's all manageable. A one-person company feels genuinely possible now, in a way it didn't a few years ago. Signup is required since the AI features cost money to run; new accounts get 100 free credits after email verification. Happy to answer questions about the product, the workflow, or the moat question. I'd genuinely like to hear how others are thinking about it.

projects.title: Show HN: Caspian – Desktop app to build and launch small vibe-coded projects
projects.author: sshussain270
projects.summary: Hi! I am Hussain and I built Caspian. For someone who vibe builds almost all the time, for both personal tools like investment or health dashboards or tools to help others, I found my projects scattered all over the place: researching with claude, writing context in notion, building with Claude Code, Devin, publishing in vercel, posthog for analytics and then others tools for GTM. Big part of brain energy drain was context switching, I wasn't very organized. So I decided to build that lets me do all this from one place. I built Caspian. While most AI coding tools you use for vibe building stop at code, Caspian takes it all the way to users. Caspian creates a "workbench" folder in your local machine where it puts all your projects so everything stays in one place and is also easy for your other tools to work with. There is a built in co-pilot, a context manager (.md files user can copilot both read/write), a one click publisher, analytics and an email outreach manager. Though the copilot uses API for processing LLM requests via open router (I make a little margin on top), it is pricy, so I build a standard "canvas" format that Caspian uses that your Claude/Codex or other tools you use also understand and can work with. Simply point them to https://caspian.md/docs and they'll learn to work with Caspian straight away, this is so that you're not tied to Caspian's co-pilot and if you prefer to use your own tools, you can do so. Some other features I built around problems i found myself struggle with: - Prompt refinement: Enter a vague prompt in co-pilot, caspian uses a cheap model to generate a detailed before starting the task. - Preflight: It breaks down the task and tells you estimatedly, how much will it cost and how long will it take, before starting the task. - Product and User context: Co-pilot has access to the two files so both you and Caspain has understand of your product and user. - Code/No code: You can switch this button to dive into code or just stick with the vibes. I hope it helps and you can build and launch a lot quickly. Feedback what's the most annoying thing when you vibe code?

projects.title: 集成 tailscale 的 android SSH/SFTP 终端
projects.author: netox
projects.summary: 之前分享过我的 iOS 应用 NovaScale(原名 NovaAccess), 它直接集成了 Tailscale 内核, 把 SSH/SFTP/Remote Codex 这些功能整合到一个 App 里, 无需开启 Tailscale VPN 客户端, 也可以在有 VPN 运行的情况下运行, 目前还在积极迭代基于 herdr remote 协议, 以满足像我这样重度 Tailscale 用户远程开发以及维护服务的一些需求 距离之前发贴已经有一段时间了，这期间 iOS 版本增加了很多新功能，同时也修复了一些 libtailscale 的问题(相关修复开源在 https://github.com/GalaxNet-Ltd/libtailscale 不知道为啥, 感觉 Tailscale 的 iOS 有些严重问题上游修复的不积极, 比如这个断网问题: https://github.com/tailscale/tailscale/issues/19504); 与此同时, 我也一直在用多余的 codex 额度(pro 5x 用户, 近期 reset 实在时太多了), 在开发一个全免费全开源的 Play 版本, 用来满足当时一些国内外用户提到的 android 版本需求 由于之前的一些方案感觉不理想, 在 5.6/astra 发布后又进了一些优化, 感觉逐渐达到了自己可用的情况, 甚至为 SSH terminal 增加基于 SGR 的鼠标支持(herdr 这种 mouse native 的 TUI 应用需要)基本上 Astra 一发就差不多了 最近重新把之前的 play 开发者账号用了起来, 全部委托给 codex 负责截图、描述、商店操作(甚至如何搞授权也是 codex 告诉我的, 相比 iOS 开发要复杂点), 没想到当前提交隔天就通过了 因此发在这里也分享给有需要的朋友, 提前声明如下: 1 、这是一个完全免费的应用，代码完全开源 ( https://github.com/GalaxNet-Ltd/novascale-android), 与 iOS 版本不同, 没有采用 libtailscale, 直接让 codex 基于 tailscale 源码适配 2 、半年前的最初版本大概还是 claude 做的, 感觉做的不怎么样, 当前完全由 Codex 开发, 我只负责架构文档和最终的验收, 所以可以称之外完全 AI 开发并发布的版本, 后面可能会根据用户反馈、时间和 Codex 额外会进行一些迭代; 总体上感觉满足我有时候 iPhone 没电时用 Android 手机的需求 3 、代码为 GPL 协议, 原因在于从 termux 上借了一些 terminal rendering 的代码, 这部分它的协议是 GPL 的, 因此也只能 GPL 开源 Android 版本 NovaScale 的一些主要功能如下: - 无需安装 Tailscale 官方 App ，因此可以同时使用其他 VPN - 基于 libghostty(准确说是 libghostty-vt 库) + Termux 渲染方案 - 支持鼠标操作（因此 tmux / herdr 等场景可以正常使用） - 支持剪贴板功能（包括 OSC52 ） - 支持自定义控制服务器(即支持 headscale 或其他自建 tailscale coordinator) - 内置 SFTP 文件浏览器，支持直接编辑文件, 以及少量代码类型的高度支持 - 内置浏览器，可访问 tailnet 内部的 Web 服务 - 支持后台代理，让第三方应用使用 tailnet 连接, 例如你正在使用其他非 Tailscale VPN 时，也可以配合 Termius 等 SSH 客户端连接服务器 技术架构如下: - tailscale 源码包装出 lib - russh 通过 ffi 与 tailscale lib 进行通信, 实现 ssh 通道 - 使用 termux 提供的代码实现了一个 terminal UI 的渲染 - tailscale lib 中提供一个 socks5 代理, 此代理供浏览器实现基于 MagicDNS 的访问, 同时这个代理可以提供给其他进程使用 如果你是 Android 用户，并且对此感兴趣，可以通过如下链接下载: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=cc.galaxnet.novascale 简单推广下 iOS 版 NovaScale ，它包含 Android 版的全部功能，基础功能免费, 有少量的付费功能需要订阅或买断支持: - 多 tailnet 支持 - 基于内置 Tailscale 和主机 Codex App-Server 直接交互的远程 Codex 方案(无需第三方中转) - 服务器监控 - Docker 管理 目前我还在尝试通过 herdr 的协议实现原生 herdr 支持，让它能够像 herdr remote 一样工作。 iOS 版本可通过如下链接下载: https://apps.apple.com/cn/app/novascale-%E4%B8%93%E4%B8%BA-tailscale-%E6%89%93%E9%80%A0/id6749938291 PS: 1 、最近看到 tailscale CEO 也忍不住充了点 codex 的额度, vibe 了一个内置 Tailscale 的 jellyfin 客户端, 同样也是基于 libtailscale 实现的, 有需要用户可以去他的 X 的帖子上翻翻应该能找到 testflight 2 、作为 tailscale 的重度用户, 也欢迎私信技术交流

projects.title: [开源自荐] jundizhou/easy-stock：A 股 AI 智能投研工作台
projects.author: jundizhou

github.name: jundizhou/easy-stock
github.description: A股行情分析与AI智能投研智能体：股票分析、量化交易分析、盘后复盘桌面工作台——easy stock

projects.summary: easy-stock 是一套面向个人投资者的 A 股 AI 智能投研桌面应用（Go 后端 + React/Electron 前端）。它把行情总览、趋势题材雷达、超短连板与情绪周期分析、个股 AI 分析、持仓 AI 巡检和大 V 复盘自动收集放进同一个本地优先的研究流程： 大 V 自动复盘：通过内置浏览器和 Agent 定时抓取雪球、淘股吧作者文章，自动去重归档，一键生成「今日观点共识」（共同关注 / 主要分歧 / 次日待验证条件） 超短连板分析：涨停池、连板梯队、晋级率与情绪周期算法同屏，A 股语境的短线结构分析 个股 AI 分析：先判断个股路径（情绪连板 / 趋势容量 / 趋势成长 / 震荡观察 / 弱势风险），再生成带确认条件与失效条件的专属报告 持仓 AI 巡检：最多 10 只持仓的组合健康度评分，识别题材集中、个股联动与风格错配 本地研究记忆：文章、分析记录、AI 会话全部保存在本机，API Key 不出电脑；支持 DeepSeek、OpenAI、Kimi、通义千问等主流模型 亮点 1. AI 原生而非聊天框加行情：先把题材、梯队、涨停原因、情绪整理成可计算的领域模型，再交给 AI 解释，每个结论可回溯到证据层 2. 本地优先：数据抓取、研究记忆、密钥存储全部在本机，适合对隐私敏感的个人投资者 3. 开箱即用：桌面安装包无需安装 Node/Go/Python，最新版已默认适配 DeepSeek V4 模型（deepseek-v4-pro / flash） 项目基于 PolyForm Noncommercial 协议（源码可用，个人学习研究免费），851 star，欢迎 ISSUE 反馈与交流。

projects.summary: 一款开源（MIT）的 macOS 读书应用。导入自己的 EPUB、PDF、MOBI/AZW3、DOCX 或 TXT，选一档想了解的深浅（从「知道个大概」到「完整走一遍」），它会按书的目录和章节内容排出一条路径，每一站是几页配语音朗读和字幕的幻灯片。适合没时间读完一本书、又不想只看二手书评的人。 亮点 结构来自原文：路径由目录和各章笔记编排，每一站都记录来源章节，不依赖模型对这本书的「记忆」，冷门书也不会凭空编出章节 时长决定站数：四档时长由这本书自己的字数和章节结构算出，时间紧时整站删掉，而不是把每站讲浅 边听边生成：第 1 站好了就能播放，后面的站按你的收听进度在后台继续生成 十四种幻灯片版式：时间线、对比、流程、矩阵、因果链等，由从章节中提取的结构化信息驱动 伴读助手：随时针对当前这本书提问，回答中引用原书的话会先和章节原文核对，并附上出处链接 模型自选：支持 OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini、DeepSeek、OpenRouter 以及任意 OpenAI 兼容接口（包括本地模型）；生成的书只存在本机，没有任何 Cairn 服务器 中英文书都支持，朗读语言跟着书走，而不是跟着界面
